changeSet.author: otchet
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO study_property (study_id, key, type, value) SELECT sp.study_id, k.key, 'json', (sp.value::jsonb -> k.key)::text FROM study_property sp CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('models'), ('workspaces'), ('presentations'), ('publications'), ('clinicalTrials'), ('intellectualProperties'), ('biospecimens'), ('funding') ) AS k(key) WHERE sp.key = 'assets' AND jsonb_typeof(sp.value::jsonb) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(sp.value::jsonb -> k.key) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(sp.value::jsonb -> k.key) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM study_property existing WHERE existing.study_id = sp.study_id AND existing.key = k.key );

changeSet.author: otchet
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE study_property SET value = ( value::jsonb - 'models' - 'workspaces' - 'presentations' - 'publications' - 'clinicalTrials' - 'intellectualProperties' - 'biospecimens' - 'funding' )::text WHERE key = 'assets' AND jsonb_typeof(value::jsonb) = 'object';
DELETE FROM study_property WHERE key = 'assets' AND jsonb_typeof(value::jsonb) = 'object' AND value::jsonb = '{}'::jsonb;
